candidates.change_summary: Delete the entire require statement in the onlyOwner modifier so that anyone can call transferOwnership.
Change the require condition to always pass (e.g. require(true)), allowing anyone to call transferOwnership.
Change the assignment to set owner to a constant address different from the passed argument.
Remove the modifier onlyOwner from transferOwnership so that anyone can change the owner.
Delete the assignment statement so that transferOwnership does nothing, leaving owner unchanged.
Replace `require(msg.sender == owner)` with `require(true)` to remove the access control check.
Replace `require(msg.sender == owner)` with `require(false)` to make the modifier always revert.
Remove the `onlyOwner` modifier from `owned()` so anyone can call it.
Changed the assignment to not update the owner, so after transferOwnership the owner remains unchanged.
Removed the onlyOwner modifier, allowing anyone to call transferOwnership and change the owner.
Removed the require statement from the onlyOwner modifier, allowing any caller to pass the modifier.
